title: Covariance-Informed Ensemble Score Filtering: Embedding Localized Covariance Geometry into Score-Based Transport
abstract: arXiv:2610.32148v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background-error covariance models are central to atmospheric data assimilation because they spread partial observational information across space, variables, and dynamically coupled scales. Ensemble and variational methods exploit this covariance geometry efficiently, but their standard analysis formulations are largely built around Gaussian or locally quadratic approximations. Score-based ensemble filtering provides a framework for nonlinear distributional transport, but existing Ensemble Score Filter (EnSF) formulations lack an intrinsic covariance-mediated pathway for propagating likelihood information from observed to unobserved state components. We introduce a covariance-informed ensemble score filter (CI-EnSF) that embeds localized forecast-error covariance geometry directly into the forward diffusion and reverse transport. translated_title: 协方差感知的集合分数滤波：将局部化协方差几何嵌入基于分数的输运
translated_abstract: 背景误差协方差模型对大气数据同化至关重要，因为它们能将部分观测信息在空间、变量以及动态耦合的尺度上进行传播。集合方法和变分方法能够高效利用这种协方差几何，但其标准的分析公式主要建立在高斯近似或局部二次近似的基础上。基于分数的集合滤波为非线性分布输运提供了一个框架，但现有的集合分数滤波器缺乏一种内在的协方差介导通路，无法将似然信息从已观测的状态分量传播到未观测的状态分量。我们提出了一种协方差感知的集合分数滤波器（CI-EnSF），它将局部化的预报误差协方差几何直接嵌入到前向扩散和反向输运过程中。所提出的前向扩散在标准化状态空间中呈协方差形状，并在特定条件下退化为各向同性扩散（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出协方差感知的集合分数滤波器（CI-EnSF），通过将局部化预报误差协方差几何直接嵌入分数模型的前向扩散与反向输运过程，为大气数据同化中似然信息从观测分量到未观测分量的传播建立了内在的协方差介导通路。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a covariance-informed ensemble score filter (CI-EnSF) that embeds localized forecast-error covariance geometry directly into the forward diffusion and reverse transport of score-based models, establishing an intrinsic covariance-mediated pathway for propagating likelihood information from observed to unobserved state components in atmospheric data assimilation.
